post.description: Registers a new affiliate user with personal information and payout account details (Mobile Money or Bank Account). Initial status is set to PENDING awaiting admin approval.

message.example: Affiliate application submitted successfully. Please wait for admin approval.

post.description: Authenticates affiliate credentials and returns session tokens. Login is restricted if affiliate application is PENDING, REJECTED, SUSPENDED, or DEACTIVATED.
Authenticates a revenue-share partner and returns JWT Bearer token.
Sends password reset instructions to partner email.
Registers or updates a push subscription for the authenticated user.
Removes a push subscription matching the given endpoint for the authenticated user.

patch.description: Updates the read status of all unread notifications for the authenticated user to true.

Fetches details of a single activity log by its ID.

post.description: Allows admins to create a new user account. Passwords are encrypted using argon2.

get.description: Fetches a list of all user accounts with pagination, filtering, and search functionality.
Fetches details of a single user account by its ID.

patch.description: Updates user account information. If email or phone changes, checks uniqueness. If password is provided, hashes it.

delete.description: Permanently deletes a user account. Admins cannot delete themselves.

patch.summary: Activate or deactivate a user account
patch.description: Updates the isActive flag for the specified user account. Deactivating a user revokes all their active sessions immediately.

message.example: User account has been deactivated successfully.

get.description: Retrieves the current active prices and availability (limit reached status) of WASSCE/NOVDEC and BECE vouchers for display on the public website. Stock limits are hidden for security.

post.description: Creates the single configuration record for prices and stock limits for WASSCE/NOVDEC and BECE vouchers. Only one config record is allowed in the entire system.

get.description: Fetches the current prices, limits, and currency configuration settings.

put.description: Updates prices and low stock alert thresholds for result checker vouchers.

delete.description: Removes the voucher pricing and alert configuration setting from the database.

put.description: Updates official release dates for WASSCE/NOVDEC and BECE exams.

post.description: Allows upload of result checker vouchers using a CSV or Excel (.xlsx/.xls) file. The file is uploaded to Cloudinary as a raw backup and parsed. Required file columns: [Serial Number, Pin Number]. All records will be assigned the selected voucher type.

201.description: File processed and vouchers uploaded successfully

type.description: Voucher type for all rows in the file

file.description: CSV or Excel file with columns: [Serial Number, Pin Number]

post.summary: Dry-run check for bulk voucher duplicates (CSV/Excel)
post.description: Parses the uploaded CSV/Excel file and compares pins/serials against the database to report duplicates. Does not insert any records.

200.description: File processed and duplicates reported successfully

type.description: Voucher type for all rows in the file

file.description: CSV or Excel file with columns: [Serial Number, Pin Number]

post.description: Manually creates a single results checker voucher record.

get.description: Fetches available, sold, and total counts for WASSCE/NOVDEC and BECE vouchers.

200.description: Voucher stock levels overview retrieved successfully

get.description: Returns a list of all single and bulk voucher uploads completed by administrators.

get.summary: Get upload history detail by ID
get.description: Fetches details of a specific single or bulk voucher upload history record including metadata and list of uploaded vouchers.
Convenience endpoint to retrieve a paginated list of sold vouchers.

Fetches detail of a single results checker voucher.

patch.description: Updates details such as status, pin, serial number, and type for a results checker voucher.

delete.description: Permanently deletes a results checker voucher from the database.

get.description: Returns the full PIN for one voucher. The access is recorded in the activity log.
Retrieves official published WAEC BECE and WASSCE/NOVDEC timetable details and download links for website cards.
Retrieves all examination timetable configurations (BECE & WASSCE/NOVDEC) including published and draft items.

patch.description: Creates or updates metadata (title, examYear, startDate, description, isPublished) and/or replaces the timetable file (PDF, DOC, DOCX) for a given type (BECE or WASSCE_NOVDEC).

delete.description: Deletes USSD dialer records and puts order-derived contacts behind a cut-off. Orders themselves are never deleted.

get.summary: Count the recipients a bulk SMS campaign would reach

post.description: Dispatches an SMS campaign to BECE customers. Division options: ALL (all unique BECE orders & BECE USSD dialers), SUCCESSFUL (successful BECE orders), FAILED_ONLY (failed/pending BECE orders).

title.description: Campaign identifier or subject line for logs

post.description: Dispatches an SMS campaign to WASSCE NOVDEC customers. Division options: ALL (all unique WASSCE orders & WASSCE USSD dialers), SUCCESSFUL (successful WASSCE orders), FAILED_ONLY (failed/pending WASSCE orders).

title.description: Campaign identifier or subject line for logs

post.description: Dispatches an SMS campaign to CTVET/NABTEX customers. Division options: ALL, SUCCESSFUL, FAILED_ONLY.
Dispatches a custom direct SMS to a specific phone number. Note: The recipient phone number can be any custom number, and does not need to exist in the database.

title.description: SMS subject line or campaign identifier for logs

get.description: Generates comprehensive statistics and metrics for the main admin dashboard, including financial summaries, stock allocations, channel splits, monthly revenue trends, and recent activities.
Generates aggregated report statistics over a rolling 6-month period, including monthly revenue by exam type, success vs failure rates, and customer acquisition splits (new vs returning).

post.description: Processes incoming interactive USSD checkout requests originating from an assigned Affiliate USSD extension code.
Invoked by Hubtel upon successful payment of an affiliate USSD order. Confirms the payment with Hubtel, allocates vouchers, dispatches SMS, and credits affiliate commission.

get.description: Retrieves live dashboard statistics for the logged-in affiliate: total vouchers sold, lifetime sales value, approved commission, total withdrawn amount, pending withdrawals, and available withdrawable balance.
Retrieves a list of successful voucher orders generated through the affiliate USSD extension.

post.description: Submits a request to withdraw available approved earnings. Enforces minimum withdrawal limits and admin-configured daily withdrawal caps.

patch.description: Updates personal information (fullName, businessName, location, phoneNumber, email) for the logged-in affiliate.

get.description: Retrieves a list of all affiliate applications and profiles with filtering by status (PENDING, APPROVED, REJECTED, SUSPENDED, DEACTIVATED) and text search.

post.description: Directly registers and creates an affiliate profile with assigned status and optional USSD code.

patch.description: Updates commission rates per voucher type sold, minimum withdrawal request amounts, and daily withdrawal caps per affiliate.

post.description: Executes an immediate money withdrawal transfer for an administrator to a dynamic Mobile Money account or Bank Account with strict payload validation.

delete.description: Permanently deletes an affiliate profile and user account.

patch.description: Updates affiliate account status (APPROVED, REJECTED, SUSPENDED, DEACTIVATED). Allows setting/updating USSD code upon approval, or providing a rejection reason.
